mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_scheduled_task ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT * FROM system_scheduled_task WHERE enabled = 1 AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_run_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE system_scheduled_task SET description = #{description}, interval_minutes = #{intervalMinutes}, enabled = #{enabled}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_code = #{taskCode}

UPDATE system_scheduled_task SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND enabled = 1 AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})
UPDATE system_scheduled_task SET next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{owner}
